title: Model Immunization Cannot Reliably Protect Models from Harmful Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29815v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Efficient fine-tuning techniques have substantially reduced the cost of adapting open-weight models, enabling malicious actors to readily fine-tune them toward harmful capabilities. In response, model immunization modifies a pretrained checkpoint to resist subsequent adaptation toward designated harmful capabilities while preserving its utility and adaptability for benign tasks. Furthermore, a few immunization methods have sought to keep their protection robust to some changes in the attacker's adaptation. However, fine-tuning offers attackers many more low-cost options, and we observe that existing methods still substantially overfit to the attacker configuration they are optimized against. Such overfitting stays hidden when immunization is evaluated under, or near, this configuration, so the reported protection may give a false sense of security. translated_title: 模型免疫无法可靠地保护模型免受有害适应性调整
translated_abstract: 高效的微调技术大幅降低了适配开放权重模型的成本，使恶意行为者能够轻易地通过微调使模型获得有害能力。作为应对，模型免疫通过修改预训练模型检查点，使其在保持对良性任务的效用和可适应性的同时，抵抗后续针对特定有害能力的适配。此外，一些免疫方法试图使其保护对攻击者适配方式的某些变化保持鲁棒。然而，微调为攻击者提供了更多低成本的选择，我们观察到现有方法仍然在很大程度上过拟合于其所针对优化的攻击者配置。当免疫在该配置下或接近该配置下进行评估时，这种过拟合会被隐藏，因此所报告的保护效果可能给人带来虚假的安全感。为了严格评估模型免疫，我们进行了实验，通过改变某一组件……
tldr: 现有模型免疫方法严重过拟合于其优化的特定攻击者配置，面对攻击者多样的低成本微调手段时无法提供可靠保护，且常规评估方式会掩盖这种过拟合，造成虚假的安全感。
en_tdlr: Existing model immunization methods substantially overfit to the specific attacker configuration they are optimized against, failing to reliably protect models from the diverse low-cost harmful fine-tuning options available to attackers, while standard evaluations mask this overfitting and create a false sense of security.
